However, the role and mechanisms for metformin in preventing cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity remains largely unknown. Metformin for preventing the progression of chronic kidney disease. Metformin has been used in the management of diabetes for decades. It is an effective, low-cost intervention with a well-established safety profile. Emerging evidence suggests that metformin targets a number of pathways that lead to chronic kidney damage, and long-term use may, therefore, slow the rate of kidney function decline and chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression.
